name: Grilled Vegetables
steps: Cut the zucchini, bell pepper and red onion into thick pieces and halve the mushrooms.
Toss with the olive oil, salt and pepper.
Grill or roast at 450°F for 10 to 12 minutes, turning once, until browned at the edges.
source: DiaBite recipe, 24 November 2026: the everyday side people mean by grilled or roasted vegetables
